- [an.semantic.matcher](_autosummary/an.semantic.matcher.html.md): The three queries and the policy (ADR 0002 decision 4): &#96;applicable&#96;, &#96;why_not&#96;, &#96;resolve&#96;.
- [an.semantic.prompt](_autosummary/an.semantic.prompt.html.md): The &#96;an iterate&#96; system prompt, generated from the vocabulary registry.
- [an.semantic.registry](_autosummary/an.semantic.registry.html.md): The one vocabulary registry (ADR 0003 decision 6): entries and aspects, by owner.
- [an.semantic.seeds](_autosummary/an.semantic.seeds.html.md): The core’s vocabulary: views over the kind and easing registries, camera moves, IR fields.
- [an.semantic.views](_autosummary/an.semantic.views.html.md): View spaces: what a camera move moves through, defined once for every engine (an#257).
- [an.sounds](_autosummary/an.sounds.html.md): Sound assets: what the sound layer plays, where it came from, and a synthesizer.
- [an.stage](_autosummary/an.stage.html.md): The 2D stage: the default engine, shipped with &#96;an&#96; but outside the core (an#247).
- [an.stage.cache_key](_autosummary/an.stage.cache_key.html.md): What a cut-out shot render reads: the keyer behind its shot-cache key (ADR 0004).
- [an.stage.canvas_capture](_autosummary/an.stage.canvas_capture.html.md): The canvas capture path: frames read from the page, not photographed off the screen.
- [an.stage.compile](_autosummary/an.stage.compile.html.md): Compile a top-level &#96;Shot&#96; (renderer=”cutout”) into a &#96;CutoutSceneJSON&#96;.
- [an.stage.easing](_autosummary/an.stage.easing.html.md): The stage engine’s easing vocabulary — a view of &#96;an.timing.easing&#96;.
- [an.stage.environments](_autosummary/an.stage.environments.html.md): Environments: a stage made of planes, at declared depths.
- [an.stage.fidelity](_autosummary/an.stage.fidelity.html.md): How faithfully a compiled scene reproduces the art it was built from.
- [an.stage.path_geometry](_autosummary/an.stage.path_geometry.html.md): Stroked-path geometry — the executable spec of &#96;runtime.js::pathGeometry&#96;.
- [an.stage.paths](_autosummary/an.stage.paths.html.md): Stroked paths: routes, invasion arrows, borders, timelines, connectors.
- [an.stage.preview](_autosummary/an.stage.preview.html.md): Live preview server: render a project’s current scene in a browser, reloading on edit.
- [an.stage.props](_autosummary/an.stage.props.html.md): Props: a rig whose art is not a person.
- [an.stage.raster](_autosummary/an.stage.raster.html.md): Raster art: what a PNG, JPEG or WebP is, read from its header (an#211).
- [an.stage.render](_autosummary/an.stage.render.html.md): The 2D stage engine (&#96;runtime.js&#96; in headless Chromium), and the cut-out renderer built on it.
- [an.stage.runtime](_autosummary/an.stage.runtime.html.md): Cutout JS runtime — see README.md in this directory.
- [an.stage.runtime_files](_autosummary/an.stage.runtime_files.html.md): Locate the bundled cutout JS runtime files.
- [an.stage.serialize](_autosummary/an.stage.serialize.html.md): JSON contract between the Python compiler and the (future) JS runtime.
- [an.stage.surface](_autosummary/an.stage.surface.html.md): Surface treatments, compiled (an#163 gap 5): outline, paper-gap shadow, glow, grain.
- [an.stage.text](_autosummary/an.stage.text.html.md): Words on screen: title cards, labels, and text you can animate word by word.
- [an.stage.text_layout](_autosummary/an.stage.text_layout.html.md): A text block, compiled: one node per unit, each an SVG sprite (an#155).
- [an.stage.timeline](_autosummary/an.stage.timeline.html.md): Stage timeline helpers: the compiled scene as a &#96;Timeline&#96;, and screen space.
- [an.stores](_autosummary/an.stores.html.md): Project mall: a dict of dol-backed &#96;MutableMapping&#96; stores.
- [an.stores.artifacts](_autosummary/an.stores.artifacts.html.md): Artifact stores — derived, regeneratable products of the pipeline.
- [an.stores.characters](_autosummary/an.stores.characters.html.md): Characters store — descriptor + sidecar folder per character.
- [an.stores.decisions](_autosummary/an.stores.decisions.html.md): Decision log — append-only JSONL of agent decisions and user approvals.
- [an.stores.environments](_autosummary/an.stores.environments.html.md): Environments store — backgrounds, set pieces, and prop bundles.
- [an.stores.library_lock](_autosummary/an.stores.library_lock.html.md): The project lockfile: which library version each checked-out asset came from.
- [an.stores.props](_autosummary/an.stores.props.html.md): Props store — descriptor + sidecar folder per prop.
- [an.stores.scenes](_autosummary/an.stores.scenes.html.md): Scenes store — wraps the project’s &#96;scene.md&#96; + &#96;ir/scene.json&#96; pair.
- [an.stores.sounds](_autosummary/an.stores.sounds.html.md): Sounds store — one directory per sound: &#96;sound.json&#96; beside &#96;audio.wav&#96;.
- [an.stores.sources](_autosummary/an.stores.sources.html.md): The project’s opaque scene sources: files a whole-shot renderer runs as they are.
- [an.stores.styles](_autosummary/an.stores.styles.html.md): Styles store — visual style presets (color palette, line weight, fonts).
- [an.stores.voices](_autosummary/an.stores.voices.html.md): Voices store — pure JSON; one entry per voice.
- [an.styles](_autosummary/an.styles.html.md): StylePack: art direction as a document, and the first reader the styles store has had.
- [an.text](_autosummary/an.text.html.md): Moved to &#96;an.stage.text&#96; (an#247); this path is a LIVE alias of it.
- [an.timing](_autosummary/an.timing.html.md): The timing kernel: what is on screen at time &#96;t&#96;, as a pure function.
- [an.timing.address](_autosummary/an.timing.address.html.md): The address grammar: one way to name an animatable value, in every genre.
- [an.timing.channel](_autosummary/an.timing.channel.html.md): Channel: keyframes for a single (target, property) pair, evaluated at time t.
- [an.timing.clip](_autosummary/an.timing.clip.html.md): Clip: a named bundle of channels with a duration and loop mode.
- [an.timing.contract](_autosummary/an.timing.contract.html.md): The timing kernel’s cross-language contract: five JSON files, generated from the registries.
- [an.timing.easing](_autosummary/an.timing.easing.html.md): The easing registry: every named timing curve, each with the solver that computes it.
- [an.timing.flat](_autosummary/an.timing.flat.html.md): The authored flat timeline: &#96;(start, end, address, change)&#96; rows.
- [an.timing.kinds](_autosummary/an.timing.kinds.html.md): Field kinds: the declared interpolator of each animatable property.
- [an.timing.spaces](_autosummary/an.timing.spaces.html.md): Property spaces: what an entity kind’s properties ARE, declared once.
- [an.timing.timeline](_autosummary/an.timing.timeline.html.md): Timeline: tracks of placed clips with absolute times — the compiled evaluation form.
- [an.tools](_autosummary/an.tools.html.md): User-facing utility functions, plus the SSOT list for CLI dispatch.
- [an.util](_autosummary/an.util.html.md): Internal helpers: file I/O, hashing, time arithmetic, light path utilities.
- [an.verify](_autosummary/an.verify.html.md): Verification protocol — same interface for human, lint, vision-LM, MoVer.
- [an.verify.human](_autosummary/an.verify.human.html.md): HumanInTheLoopVerifier — opens the rendered mp4 and asks for approval.
- [an.verify.layout](_autosummary/an.verify.layout.html.md): LayoutLintVerifier — cheap pre-render checks on the IR.
- [an.verify.media](_autosummary/an.verify.media.html.md): Media verification helpers — audio + frame quality checks for rendered mp4s.
- [an.verify.media_quality](_autosummary/an.verify.media_quality.html.md): MediaQualityVerifier — post-render quality checks on the actual mp4.
- [an.verify.prosody](_autosummary/an.verify.prosody.html.md): Prosody measurement: how a recorded voice delivers its words, as numbers a target can check.
- [an.verify.style](_autosummary/an.verify.style.html.md): Style lint: measure a render’s cadence, cut rate and palette, and compare them to a style’s targets.
- [an.verify.vision](_autosummary/an.verify.vision.html.md): VisionLMVerifier — Claude vision looks at sampled frames and reports issues.
